test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a triangle, right angled at B, AB = 12 cm and BC = 5 cm. What will be the value of

i) sin A cos A

ii) sin C cos C respectively?
solution:
Given:

In a triangle, right angled at B, AB = 12 cm and BC = 5 cm.

Concept used:

Pythagoras Theorem

Sin θ = Height over Hypotenuse

Cos θ = Base over Hypotenuse

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e389d3c2a0149c7493ba9b9716f671b57a60eaefa4a3d5f655f2dc5f27811c1.png] 

Thus, AC = {sqrt {12² +5²}} = 13 cm

Sin A = 5 over 13

Cos A = 12 over 13

Hence, Sin A Cos A = 60 over 169

Sin C = 12 over 13

Cos C = 5 over 13

Hence, Sin C Cos C = 60 over 169

∴ Option 2 is the answer.
